items.title: Emmanuel Sayles Interview, 1959-01-17
items.q: like Cleveland Williams had a name around Donisonville.

ctx.x: Yeah, and those bands were like, I remember well, and then the band off the boat, Faith Marble off the boat, they used to hire him sometimes to play because they would come after their job. You see, their job would close about twelve o'clock, and they would come and play, the dance would last, well, maybe about three o'clock, something, two-thirty or three o'clock. See, well that was an added attraction, see, where people would come out there because they couldn't hear the Faith Marble band on the boat, you know,…
Did you ever hear Bud Scott or Walter Vons up there? In Natchez, by the way, where we were mentioning? Bud Scott?
